notes: Tasks use a fixed 'time', or an 'anchor' (wake or lightsOut) plus 'offset' minutes, so they move with the sleep shift. days: 0=Sun ... 6=Sat; no days = every day.

tasks.name: Out of bed
tasks.push: Feet on the floor. Don't negotiate with the bed. Open Daybreak.

tasks.name: Wash face
tasks.push: Brush teeth, wash face, cold water. Two minutes.

tasks.name: Make the bed
tasks.push: Make the bed. Once it's made, you can't crawl back in.

tasks.name: Morning stretch (10 min)
tasks.push: 10-minute morning stretch. Today's flow is in Daybreak.

tasks.name: Morning walk (15 min)
tasks.push: Morning walk, 15 minutes outside. Daylight in your eyes resets your body clock, so waking early gets easier.

tasks.name: Real breakfast
tasks.push: Breakfast. Daybreak has a recipe ready for you.

tasks.name: Set today's one thing
tasks.push: What's the one thing that makes today a win? Write it down.

tasks.name: School work
tasks.push: School block. Phone in another room, start with the smallest task.

tasks.name: Lunch
tasks.push: Lunch time. Eat something real, not just a snack.

tasks.name: TESOL course
tasks.push: TESOL time. Even 25 minutes counts. Start now.

tasks.name: Afternoon walk
tasks.push: Walk before the sun goes down. Shoes on, out the door, 20 minutes.

tasks.name: Cook dinner
tasks.push: Cook tonight. Tonight's recipe is in Daybreak.

tasks.name: Read
tasks.push: Read 15 pages. Paper, not phone.

tasks.name: Write
tasks.push: Write a few lines. Anything counts.

tasks.name: Gym (1 hour)
tasks.push: Gym. Pack the bag and go. Tonight's plan is in Daybreak.

tasks.name: Bedtime stretch + light exercise (20 min)
tasks.push: No gym tonight. 20 minutes of stretching and light exercise before bed. Tonight's routine is in Daybreak.

tasks.name: Shower + 10-minute room reset
tasks.push: Shower, then a 10-minute room reset. Clothes, dishes, desk.

tasks.name: Wash face
tasks.push: Brush teeth, wash face. Winding down.

tasks.name: Check-in + tomorrow's one thing
tasks.push: Evening check-in, then pick tomorrow's one thing.

tasks.name: Phone away, lights out
tasks.push: Phone across the room, alarm across the room too. Lights out.
